Indra: Quick follow-up on loader header v2: we want a tiny, <=4KB prefix that lets the runtime decide warmup + atomic-swap safety without pulling model bytes. Core pieces: format, shard_count, manifest_digest, range_index_digest, min_loader_version, lease_pub_hmac, flags.
Sam: Sounds good. For lease_pub_hmac: do you mean a public key id + HMAC seed? How do readers validate locally?
Indra: Idea: local cache manager signs a short lease token (HMAC over pointer_digest+expiry) with a node-local key. Readers carry token; eviction checks verify expiry+HMAC before delete. No global RPC.
Clare: That avoids per-read RPCs. But we must handle node crashes: if a node dies holding valid leases, eviction should wait lease expiry + a grace window before reclaim. Document expected SLOs.
Jia: For gzipped bundles we won't embed offsets in header; header points to a lightweight range-index object (compact binary sidecar) via range_index_digest. The runtime fetches that index if it plans range reads.
Sam: Pointer semantics for atomic swap: write artifact to a versioned path, write a small JSON pointer (pointer file) containing header_digest and loader_hint, then atomic rename or atomic write+fsync for filesystems that support it. Use conditional GETs / If-Match on the pointer for object stores.
Clare: Warmup strategies should be explicit enum: cheap_probe, index_prefetch, eager_full, stream_lazy. Telemetry: warmup_strategy, header_probe_ms, bytes_prefetched, lease_hit_rate, swap_failures.
Indra: Backcompat: if no header found, treat as legacy blob and use index_prefetch or full eager depending on size. Add a loader flag to opt into header-only probing.
Jia: I'll build a tiny parser that mmap's first page for local FS and fetches first 4KB via range request for HTTP. Will measure p50/p99 and IO bytes for small vs large models.
runtime-bot: Tests queued: header_v2_parse, pointer_race_sim, lease_expiry_reclaim. CI job eng-ml/header-v2 (#504).
Indra: Action items: Jia spike range-index + perf, Sam write header schema PR, Clare draft eviction grace windows, I'll update RFC and add telemetry keys. Keep replies short so we can merge next week. :thumbsup:
